content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Class VIII pass or equivalent; Dependent family member of a person killed in political violence on or after 01.01.2001, as defined under the Scheme; Citizen of India and resident of West Bengal; Monthly family income from all sources not above Rs. 50,000/- Age limit: Maximum 18 years (as on 1 January 2026) Other conditions: Must be a dependent family member of a person killed in political violence on or after 01.01.2001, as defined under the Scheme Must be a citizen of India and a resident of West Bengal Monthly family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 50,000/-

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for District Magistrate Kalimpong Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Families in which any member is in regular Government service Families in which any member is an income-tax assessee/payer More than one member of the same affected family (only one eligible member is considered)

content_sections.text: Death Certificate of the deceased; FIR, Final Police Report/Chargesheet and relevant Court records, wherever applicable Proof of relationship with the deceased and proof of ordinary residence in West Bengal Educational qualification certificate and proof of age Income Certificate issued by the concerned BDO/SDO Two recent passport-size photographs and affidavit in prescribed Form-D No Objection Certificate from other dependent family members; any other relevant supporting documents

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for District Magistrate Kalimpong Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Obtain the prescribed application form (Form-A to Form D), the Scheme and other forms from kalimpong.gov.in. Fill in Form-A, addressed to the District Magistrate, Kalimpong. Attach self-attested copies of all supporting documents, including the affidavit in Form-D. Submit the completed application to the Office of the District Magistrate, Kalimpong, on or before 07.12.2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District Magistrate Kalimpong Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for District Magistrate Kalimpong Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Form-A to Form D, the Scheme and other relevant forms at kalimpong.gov.in) and send it to Office of the District Magistrate, Kalimpong, by offline, to reach by 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for District Magistrate Kalimpong Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 18 years (as on 1 January 2026).

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Class VIII pass or equivalent (minimum educational qualification prescribed for Group 'D' posts).

faq.question: Q5. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a dependent family member of a person killed in political violence on or after 01.01.2001, as defined under the Scheme. Must be a citizen of India and a resident of West Bengal. Monthly family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 50,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Families in which any member is in regular Government service. Families in which any member is an income-tax assessee/payer. More than one member of the same affected family (only one eligible member is considered).

faq.question: Q7. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
Q8. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Death Certificate of the deceased; FIR, Final Police Report/Chargesheet and relevant Court records, wherever applicable; Proof of relationship with the deceased and proof of ordinary residence in West Bengal; Educational qualification certificate and proof of age; Income Certificate issued by the concerned BDO/SDO; Two recent passport-size photographs and affidavit in prescribed Form-D; No Objection Certificate from other dependent family members; any other relevant supporting documents.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number of this recruitment?
faq.answer: It is Advt No. KPG-18011(99)/9/2026-ESTT SEC.
